Retrieve codes observed in a Dataflow for a time window

Source: R/availability.R
tuik_available_codes.Rd

Returns values of a dimension that are actually present in data returned by the selected Dataflow over a bounded period. This is intentionally distinct from tuik_dimension_codes(), which returns the theoretical Codelist domain.

Usage

tuik_available_codes(
  profile,
  dimension,
  start_period,
  end_period,
  filters = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  api_key = NULL,
  query_mode = c("auto", "all"),
  allow_all = FALSE
)

Arguments

profile

A tuik_flow_profile object.

dimension

Dimension ID whose observed values should be returned.

start_period

Required start period.

end_period

Required end period.

filters

Optional named list of dimension filters. Filter values are validated against Codelists, and reapplied locally to the returned data.

labels

Logical. If TRUE, attach Turkish and English Codelist labels when the dimension references a Codelist.

api_key

Optional API key. If NULL, the TUIK_SDMX_API_KEY environment variable is used.

query_mode

"auto" (default) uses a complete server-side SDMX key when possible. "all" always requests all series for the period. The all path requires allow_all = TRUE in either mode.

allow_all

Logical. Explicitly authorizes a potentially large all download if filters are partial/absent or query_mode = "all". This does NOT impose a byte, row, memory, or timeout limit.

Value

A tibble with observed code values, row counts and optional labels.

Details

By default query_mode = "auto" uses a server-side key for complete filters. Partial or absent filters require the explicit allow_all = TRUE opt-in because the service may return a large all response. query_mode = "all" also requires allow_all = TRUE. Both period bounds are required. Period bounds do not impose a limit on response size or memory usage. This is observed data availability, not an SDMX ContentConstraint.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
tuik_available_codes(
  profile,
  dimension = "COICOP_2018",
  start_period = "2026-01",
  end_period = "2026-03",
  allow_all = TRUE  # No filters: explicit broad-download opt-in
)

tuik_available_codes(
  profile,
  dimension = "COICOP_2018",
  start_period = "2026-01",
  end_period = "2026-03",
  filters = list(FREQ = "M", REF_AREA = "TR"),
  allow_all = TRUE  # Partial filters: downloaded data are filtered locally
)
} # }
